text: hard, small and short. I'm 5'2" and I .... hard, small and short. I'm 5'2" and I hang off it on both ends. no padding and no back support. I keep telling myself i'm done buying from china because nothing is ever right and its all cheap. NOT FOR A WEAK OR ELDERLY PERSON, HARD TO OPEN, HARD TO CLOSE, YOU HAVE TO BE VERY STRONG TO GET THE RECLINER TO CLOSE. I HAVE TO GET UP (WHILE HOLDING IT DOWN) THEN PUSH IT CLOSED. You do get what you pay for, go to a furniture store and sit in a chair before buying it and get what you need. I'm adding a butt cushion, a lumbar cushion, heat and massage pad to this and I'll use this until it falls apart just to try to get my money out of it, then i'll put it in the lounge at my horse barn.

features: Side knob for lowering seat back and pull lever for footrest extension
description: The Arcadia Recliners Collection offer comfort, style and value. A smooth seat cushion provides relaxation from seat to toe with an easy to reach external handle for operating the reclining mechanism. Designed for exceptional comfort at appropriate price, this relaxed recliner features colored microfiber for comfort and style. A padded seat back with overstuffed pillow arms offers generous support and comfort, while you also have opportunity to choose chocolate, sage, beige or light brown microfiber fabric upholstery for a custom look. A padded accent piece, this upholstered will find its place in your living or family room.
